primary: Distant potentially large objects; retain secondary NEO,Centaur,retrograde,hyperbolic and other modes
scope: All 2548307 catalogue tracklets accounted. Dedicated proposal lane <=600arcsec/day, span<=0.6d,count>=2; no inclination/energy/brightness exclusion. Reuse prior completed million-seed general candidates; do not mislabel them new discoveries.
planetary: 128 distant +32 each retrograde,hyperbolic,NEO,general; best residual mode per chain/lane,order span/tracklets/RMS/hash;20processes,60s/parent,10s/fit,900soverall;two growth rounds,12uncertainty samples,16candidates/window,maxcone2deg;finite caps disclosed
controls: Nine existing real catalogue identities, first available season,anonymousIDs,all later observations reserved. First726-row control search; minimum one pure Varuna or2008KV42 chain before full scan. No significance/completeness claim.
limitations: Finite proposal grid and caps, not exhaustive coverage.
